name: Zinger Burger
text: A crunchy fried chicken fillet, melted cheese and our house sauce, stacked in a toasted sesame bun.

name: Beef Smash Burger Double Patty
title: Double Smash Burger
text: Two beef patties smashed hot on the griddle for crispy edges, with cheddar melting down every side.

name: Grilled Shawarma
text: Grilled chicken, garlic sauce, pickles and fries, rolled tight and toasted until the wrap crackles.

name: Loaded Fries
text: Golden fries buried under cheese sauce, crispy chicken, jalapenos and a garlic mayo drizzle.

name: Alfredo Pasta
text: Ribbons of pasta in a silky cream and parmesan sauce, topped with grilled chicken.

name: Boneless Fish Tikka
text: Boneless fish in a red tikka masala, charred over the flame and served sizzling with mint chutney.

name: BBQ Wings
text: Crispy wings tossed in a sticky, smoky glaze with sesame and spring onion.

name: Jenzy Special Doodh Patti Chai
title: Doodh Patti Chai
text: Strong tea boiled in milk with cardamom, poured from high for the froth. The way to end the night.
